name: @rootnative/devhub-example
description: An Expo app that tests the DevHub build cache provider with npx expo run. It keeps its builds in .devhub/, not in the store of the developer.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['.devhub', '.expo', '.turbo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
